levels.2: passing isolated unit or differential tests
levels.4: verified against the original DOS executable in a stated domain (three-way, scenario level)

notes: Levels are the highest level reached inside the stated domain; a subsystem can be level 2 for isolated routines and still level 5 at scenario level. Both are given.

Scenario checks run natively against references recorded once per DOS executable (build/reference/, portable/tests/acceptance/step_check.py, seconds per scenario). Native replays each DOS run's own per-site clock tape and input tape; the canonical lane (native vs canonical DOS, same tape) tests the port, the original lane tests the whole chain. Verdicts are game state per DoAntSim entry; pump counts and clock-read order are diagnostics.

scenarios.new-game-save (64 entries): canonical lane equal through entry 35, then replay stalls in the save flow (input admission); original lane replay fails before entry 1 (admission). 8-entry historical prefix equal three ways.
scenarios.quick-game (2000 entries): canonical lane equal through entry 20; entry 21 window_current_event Event.v DOS 20 / native 0 (known native-event-omitted-word: stack word the asm reads but the caller does not pass); original lane replay fails before entry 1 (admission). 8-entry historical prefix equal three ways.
scenarios.long-run (3000 entries, unattended): same as quick-game: canonical lane equal through entry 20, entry 21 Event.v; original lane replay fails before entry 1.
scenarios.original repeatability: original recorded twice: all 307 SaveRec records equal at every entry in all three scenarios; quick-game window_current_event differs from entry 1703 between repeats (observation setup differed; cause not isolated)

finish_line: Port verified faithful for normal play when every corpus scenario (new-game-save, quick-game, an unattended long run, load-from-save, experiment mode) is equal three ways in game state for its whole step count, frames and sound streams are compared at checkpoints, and the native check of all scenarios runs in under a minute as part of the port suites.
